title: Cohomology colimit cocone of a cofiltered system over a fixed scheme
statement: Let J be a small nonempty cofiltered category, S a scheme, D:J→Sch a diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transitions [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], π:D→const S a natural transformation, c a limit cone, G an abelian étale sheaf on S [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], q≥0 and j₀∈J. There exist a diagram H:Jᵒᵖ→Ab, isomorphisms e_j:H(j)≅H^q(D_j,π_j⁻¹G), additive maps r_j:H^q(S,G)→H(j), a colimit cocone B for H [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and an isomorphism e:B.pt≅H^q(c.pt,(c_j₀π_j₀)⁻¹G). Here inverse images and cohomology are those of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. For every f:j→k and x∈H^q(S,G), H(fᵒᵖ)(r_k(x))=r_j(x), e_j(r_j(x))=π_j^*(x), and e(B_j(r_j(x)))=(c_j₀π_j₀)^*(x), with pullbacks of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. No torsion condition is assumed.

proof.text: Naturality of π and the cone equation imply c_jπ_j=c_kπ_k along every arrow. A common predecessor shows that all composites equal t=c_j0π_j0.

Define H with stage cohomology groups and transition homomorphisms cohomologyTriangleMap. The triangle identity and composition laws prove the functor equations. Choose eH as identity isomorphisms and r_j as cohomologyMap π_j. The proved triangle restriction equation gives compatibility and the stage comparison equation.

Construct B with point H^q(t inverse image G) and legs given by triangle pullback along c_j. The triangle composition law and cone equation prove naturality. Use the supplied-cocone continuity theorem to obtain its colimit universal property. Choose e as the identity isomorphism.
Apply the triangle restriction equation to each projection c_j to get B_j r_j=cohomologyMap t, completing the specified comparison equation.
